Whether you're passionate about building highly scalable and reliable systems in the cloud or a software developer who likes to solve interesting and complex business problems, AWS Security is the place for you.

You will contribute to all parts of the software development and deployment lifecycle across the entire Amazon development community, including design, implementation, documentation, deployment and operations across multiple products.

They must possess strong verbal and written communication skills, be self-driven and deliver high results. They need to really enjoy working closely with their peers within a group of very talented engineers and builders.
  
  
This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Each day, hundreds of thousands of developers and customers make billions of transactions worldwide on our cloud and the Amazon retail site. Amazon Foundational Security Services owns the security bar for all of these services offered by AWS, including EC2, S3, and many others, as well as the security of our global retail sites.
  
  
We are the Access Management Services organization, part of Amazon Foundational Security Services, and we strive to provide our customers with secure by default security services which help them discover, organize, and manage resources while achieving least privilege access control with the least amount of human intervention possible. Our team works across all of Amazon and AWS to solve security challenges at massive scale relating to authorization and access control. We dive deep into security technologies such as new access control design patterns, automated workflows, and life cycle management to support our customers as Amazon continues to scale and grow.

**Job Summary And Qualifications**
The HCA Healthcare Residency Program at LewisGale Medical Center provides you with the tools necessary to succeed in today’s hospital environment. This paid program will assist you with the transition out of the classroom setting through a formalized series of learning experiences, including:
  
  

* Advanced clinical training in a specialty area.
* Monthly educational sessions.
* Preceptorship training with a facility preceptor.
* Measurement and evaluation of skills through hands-on simulations.
* Mentoring from experienced nurse leaders.
* Working collaboratively on an evidence-based practice project.

The RN Resident coordinates and delivers high quality, patient-centered care in accordance with the nature and specific requirements of the department, and consistent with the scope and standards of practice for the relevant state and specialty. In collaboration with medical providers and other members of the care team, the RN Resident provides individualized, comprehensive, and compassionate care using established nursing models such as “Assess, Perform, Teach, and Manage.” The RN Resident serves as an advocate for patients, families and caregivers to support an unparalleled patient experience.
  
  
**What will you do in this role:**

* Assess patient condition during admission and during each shift as scheduled, identifying and reporting any changes in patient status.
* Perform procedures, monitoring, or other functions as ordered by the medical provider(s). Document the administration of care in the patient medical record in a timely and thorough manner.
* Perform the administration of prescribed medications. Monitor patient for therapeutic response. Notify provider and intervene as appropriate in the event of an unintended response to medication.
* Perform exceptional care by responding promptly to patient requests. Strive to anticipate patient needs and resolve them proactively.
* Teach patients, families and caregivers about patient medical condition, patient status, treatment plan, medications and possible side effects, and follow-up measures. Translates complex medical terminology to ensure complete understanding.

* Basic Cardiac Life Support (BLS) obtained within 30 days of employment

* Registered Nurse License or Graduate Nurse in the State

**Job Description**
We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
  
  
As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Infrastructure Platforms, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems.
* Creates secure and high-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems.
* Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development.
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems.
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience.
* Advanced proficiency in one or more programming language(s) and framework(s) (e.g., Python, Django, etc.).
* Hands-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability.
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Experience in designing, deploying, and managing containerized distributed applications, with a understanding of orchestration and scaling strategies.
* Hands-on experience with AWS Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), including provisioning and operating core compute, storage, and networking services (e.g., EC2, EBS, S3, VPC)
* Experience managing infrastructure on AWS Cloud, utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform to automate and optimize deployment processes
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle.
* Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Hands-on experience with relational databases, particularly CockroachDB or similar distributed databases, ensuring data consistency, reliability, and performance in distributed environments.
* Practical cloud native experience.

Fairly is a fast growing tech-enabled vacation rental management company: we help homeowners earn more from their homes with less hassle, pairing local caretakers with software we build in-house.
  
  
We are a small, senior engineering team that works AI-native. We're adding a software engineer to the team, with an emphasis on AI automations: building workflows that use AI to do real work, making them reliable in production, and keeping a person in the loop where judgment matters.
  
  
This is a first or early-career role for someone who already builds with AI agents every day and wants to learn how production software gets built and run. You will work alongside senior engineers, in Portland, with real ownership early.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and ship AI workflows that take a process a person does by hand, do most of it, and route the exceptions to a person.
* Turn prototypes (Claude skills, n8n flows) into services with proper credentials, logging, monitoring and tests, deployed on AWS.
* Wear multiple hats across the full software development lifecycle: scope the problem with the people who have it, design, build, test, deploy, monitor and iterate, with support from senior engineers.
* Design review steps: when the model acts alone, when it drafts for approval, when it escalates.
* Work with more than one model and compare them on real cases.
* Sit with the people who own the process, find out what they actually do, and automate that.

**What You'll Bring**

* A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent projects.
* Daily use of Claude Code or a similar coding agent, and projects you can show, including how you directed the agent.
* Solid fundamentals in TypeScript or Python, git, SQL and HTTP APIs.
* Working knowledge of AWS or another cloud, enough to deploy and run what you build (Lambda, containers, queues, or similar), or the drive to learn it fast.
* Willingness to wear multiple hats: product analyst, developer, tester and operator in the same week.
* Sound judgment on when to trust model output and when to check it.
* Clear written and spoken communication. You explain what you built, what it does, and where it can fail.
* Curiosity about how a business runs.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with LLM APIs, tool calling, MCP, or an agent framework.
* Internship or project experience in React, Node or GraphQL.
* Familiarity with n8n, Zapier or similar workflow tools.

**How We Work**

* Small team, high trust, high ownership, with direct access to the CTO.
* AI-native: we expect you to use coding agents heavily and to improve how we use them.
* You own your work across the whole lifecycle, from the first conversation with the process owner to monitoring it in production.
* In person in Portland, with the hybrid arrangement TBD.

**How To Apply**
Skip the resume and cover letter. Email careers@fairly.com with the subject line "Software Engineer: Your Name" and one paragraph answering this:
  
  
Tell us about something you built that nobody asked you to build. What did it do, how did you build it (including how you worked with AI tools), and what's one thing it got wrong that you had to fix? Add a link if you can.
  
  
We're reading for specifics. If your answer could describe any project, it will not stand out. If it's interesting, we'll ask for a resume and set up a short conversation.

The Office of Inclusive Excellence is led by the Vice Provost for Inclusive Excellence and is responsible for developing and implementing programs, policies, partnerships and research with institution-wide impact. **Position Summary**
The Researcher and Data Analyst (RDA) reports to the Director of Research and Bruin Engagement and works closely with the Director of Research Strategy and Analytics. The RDA is responsible for carrying out a variety of research and analytical projects related to advancing the Inclusive Excellence mission. The RDA contributes to the design and implementation of OIE's data analytics strategy and carries out various quantitative and mixed methods research and data analysis projects. The RDA contributes expertise in data and results visualizations, translation of results into actionable advice to office and University leadership. The RDA will develop and apply multivariate and other types of statistical analyses to identify predictive and explanatory statistical associations that will guide planning and decision-making about strategic priorities of the Office of Inclusive Excellence (OIE) and will create tables, chart, graphics and narrative to convey sophisticated concepts and findings, in both written and oral formats. The position is also responsible for ensuring application of best practices in data management, including privacy and confidentiality protections, databases and data structures conformance to uniform standards, and creation of a standardized suite of query and analysis tools. The RDA may represent the Office at UC-wide and interorganizational meetings and, with peer departments within the UC system and beyond. The incumbent may also present findings at professional conferences and meetings, publish research in professional journals and keep current on relevant social science research. The RDA will contribute to or lead the identification, development, writing and submission of grant-funded research opportunities.

, we’re building systems that enable global teams to think faster, act smarter, and deliver at scale. As part of the

**Responsibilities**

* Understanding of data modeling, version control (Git), and agile delivery.
* Comfort with cross-functional collaboration across time zones and disciplines.
* Demonstrated curiosity, initiative, and self-motivation, with the ability to take ownership of work.
* Comfort working through ambiguity and unfamiliar situations to develop practical solutions.
* Seller-doer mindset, with an interest in client relationships and contributing to business development.

**Preferred**

* 3 years of experience building or delivering data, analytics, or software solutions.
* Experience or coursework in data science, machine learning, or applied AI.
* Familiarity with AWS and interoperability across cloud ecosystems.
* Exposure to Palantir Foundry or similar enterprise data platforms.
* Basic experience with DevOps CI/CD pipelines and containerized environments (Docker, GitHub Actions, or Azure Pipelines).

* Experience with Databricks, including collaborative notebooks and data engineering workflows.
* Experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI, including data modeling and visualization.

**Responsibilities**
The Data Protection team safeguards user data, business data, confidential company information, intellectual property, and other data requiring protection against unauthorized disclosure and exfiltration. We build and operate the platforms, data pipelines, and controls that help teams understand data risks and protect sensitive information across enterprise systems.
  
  
Our focus is on effective, practical protection: understanding how data is accessed, used, and shared; applying controls appropriate to its sensitivity and risk; and enabling reliable, scalable security workflows without unnecessarily disrupting legitimate work.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Engineer to build the engineering foundation of our Data Protection program. This is a software development role focused on backend services, data pipelines, platform integrations, and workflow automation.
  
  
You will turn data protection requirements into production software that connects enterprise systems, processes security and data lifecycle signals, and automates operational workflows. You will work closely with Data Security Engineers, IT, Insider Security, and data platform teams to make data protection capabilities more scalable, reliable, and measurable.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Data Protection Platform Engineering
  
- Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs for data protection capabilities, including data discovery and classification, protection coverage tracking, and policy lifecycle management.
  
- Develop integrations with enterprise DLP platforms, data infrastructure, identity services, and case-management systems through APIs, event streams, and connectors.
  
- Build reusable platform capabilities that enable security engineers to manage configurations, validate controls, and deploy changes through version-controlled, auditable workflows.
  
- Design data models and storage systems for protection metadata, security events, workflow state, and audit records, with appropriate access and retention controls.
  
  
Data Pipelines and Processing
  
- Build and operate batch and streaming pipelines to ingest, normalize, enrich, and correlate data protection signals across enterprise systems.
  
- Integrate data ownership, classification, access, and lineage context to support risk assessment, detection, and investigation workflows.
  
- Implement reliable processing with schema validation, deduplication, retries, replay, and mechanisms to handle late or out-of-order events where needed.
  
- Optimize pipeline throughput, latency, and storage costs while maintaining data quality and limiting unnecessary collection or exposure of sensitive data.
  
  
Workflow Automation
  
- Develop workflow orchestration for policy validation, event enrichment, alert routing, exception management, and remediation tracking.
  
- Integrate automated workflows with approval processes and human review where actions may affect business operations or access to data.
  
- Build reliable execution using idempotent operations, bounded retries, failure recovery, and auditable state transitions.
  
  
Reliability and Engineering Ownership
  
- Own features from requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  
- Build observability for services, connectors, pipelines, and workflows, including metrics, logs, dashboards, and actionable alerts.
  
- Write automated tests and use CI/CD, staged rollouts, and rollback strategies to deliver changes safely.
  
- Investigate production issues, address performance and reliability bottlenecks, and maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks.
  
- Collaborate with security and infrastructure partners to translate data protection needs into clear interfaces, service expectations, and maintainable software.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
- Backend Engineering: 2+ years of professional software engineering experience using Go (Golang), Java, or C++, with Go preferred. Experience building and maintaining production backend services and APIs.
  
- Distributed Systems: Working knowledge of asynchronous processing, service-to-service communication, and distributed system failure modes, including retries, idempotency, and consistency trade-offs.
  
- Big Data & Infrastructure: Experience working with high-volume data ecosystems or cloud-native infrastructure, such as Hive, Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Kubernetes; expertise in every listed technology is not required.
  
- Database Engineering: Strong understanding of database design, SQL, and NoSQL systems, including indexing, partitioning, transactions, and how data is physically stored, retained, and deleted.
  
- Software Delivery: Experience with automated testing, version control, code review, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.
  
- Collaboration: Ability to translate requirements into practical technical designs and communicate clearly with engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- Data Protection & Privacy: Prior experience in data protection, DLP, privacy engineering, GDPR/CCPA-related technical controls, or data governance.
  
- Security Engineering: Understanding of encryption at rest and in transit, identity and access management (IAM), least privilege, secrets management, and audit logging.
  
- Workflow Orchestration: Experience with workflow engines such as Temporal or Airflow, or with building durable, event-driven automation across multiple systems.
  
- Enterprise Integrations: Experience integrating security platforms, SaaS applications, identity providers, or case-management systems, including handling API rate limits and connector failures.
  
- Classification & Enrichment: Experience integrating data classification, content inspection, or LLM-based analysis into production services, with appropriate evaluation and safeguards for sensitive data, reliability, latency, and cost.

* Seller-doer mindset, with an interest in client relationships and contributing to business development.

* 3 years of experience building or delivering data, analytics, or software solutions.
* Experience or coursework in data science, machine learning, or applied AI.

* Experience with Databricks, including collaborative notebooks and data engineering workflows.
* Experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI, including data modeling and visualization.

You will work closely with perception, prediction, planning, infrastructure, systems, and hardware teams to ensure models are efficient, scalable, reliable, and production-ready for both on-vehicle and cloud workflows.

**Description**
AWS Transform is building the next generation of Agentic AI services that autonomously migrate the world's largest enterprises to the cloud. With approximately 7/8 of all enterprise workloads still running on-premises, we are at the center of one of AWS's most significant growth opportunities. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer who is excited to build at the frontier of AI — an engineer who wants to design and ship the autonomous agents that reason about complex infrastructure, make intelligent decisions, and execute large-scale migrations with minimal human intervention. This is a rare opportunity to do hands-on engineering on an AI-native platform as it takes shape.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and own major components of our Agentic AI migration platform, where autonomous agents discover, plan, and execute data center migrations.
* Implement multi-agent capabilities that leverage foundation models, chain-of-thought reasoning, and tool-use patterns to solve concrete migration challenges.
* Contribute to AI-powered network transformation features, using generative models to analyze, replicate, and optimize enterprise network topologies.
* Collaborate closely with engineers and product partners within your team, contributing to design reviews and helping maintain architectural coherence across our agent frameworks.
* Improve the autonomy and accuracy of agentic orchestration for migration of servers, storage, networks, and applications through iterative development, testing, and measurement.
* Raise the bar on engineering quality through code reviews, operational excellence, and AI-native development practices; mentor junior engineers and interns, and contribute to a culture of rapid experimentation, spec-driven engineering, and high-velocity releases on Brownfield projects.

**Description**
Do you want to shape how AWS understands and improves the experience of millions of customers? The AWS Experience Analytics team is building a unified analytics, experimentation, and user-insights platform that spans every channel customers use — web, mobile, CLI, SDK, docs, and conversational interfaces. We just shipped our first wave of capabilities and are now designing the next, much larger version: large-scale data pipelines, real-time streaming, applied ML and generative AI, and an intelligence layer that lets teams query insights in natural language. This is an early, formative stage where the architecture and engineering norms are being set, so you won't inherit a finished system — you'll help define it.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will own features end to end — from shaping requirements with product and science partners to shipping production services that AWS service teams rely on to find and fix customer friction. If you're excited about combining open-source technologies, AWS services like Redshift and Kinesis, and big-data and ML techniques to drive the future of the AWS customer experience, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, test, and operate scalable services and data pipelines that power the analytics platform, ensuring reliability and fresh data for downstream consumers.
* Own a meaningful component or feature area end to end — from system design through production deployment and ongoing operations — bringing clarity to problems and identifying simple, maintainable solutions.
* Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and partner engineering teams to translate requirements into working software that improves customer-journey and experience-health metrics.
* Contribute to code reviews and mentor teammates, raising the bar on code quality, documentation, and engineering standards across the team.
* Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and techniques where they can accelerate development or improve the platform's insights capabilities.

**About The Team**
AWS Experience Analytics is a newly formed organization with a rapidly expanding charter. We own the services and data warehouses AWS uses to gather quantitative insights (analytics, experimentation) and qualitative insights (user feedback, ratings) and turn them into actions that improve the AWS customer experience. Our customers are the service teams across AWS who need reliable metrics and tooling to understand how people use their products.
  
  
Over the coming months and years, we are investing in a unified data-collection-to-insights platform, richer customer-journey metrics across every AWS channel, behavioral segmentation powered by ML, and an agentic insights layer driven by generative AI. It's a collaborative, builder-friendly environment where engineers take on increasing scope as the platform grows.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.
  
  
Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced
**Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Engineer**
to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The AI/ML Engineer will design, deploy, and support scalable AI/ML capabilities that enable VA customers to develop, operationalize, and manage advanced analytics and intelligent applications within the Summit Data Platform.
  
  
This position will lead the technical implementation of enterprise AI/ML tooling, reusable development frameworks, and production deployment capabilities. The AI/ML Engineer will work with VA stakeholders, data engineers, and technical teams to deliver secure, reliable, and responsible AI/ML solutions that meet Government-approved operational, security, and governance requirements.
  
  
**Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.**
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise AI/ML development and deployment capabilities using Azure Machine Learning, Azure Databricks, Azure AI services, and related technologies.
* Develop and maintain reusable AI/ML solution templates, development environments, and deployment patterns that support predictive analytics, natural language processing, and generative AI applications.
* Build and optimize machine learning pipelines for data preparation, model training, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring.
* Implement Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) practices, including model versioning, registry management, automated testing, deployment workflows, and reproducibility.
* Support the integration of AI/ML models and services with Summit data assets, enterprise applications, and approved cloud infrastructure.
* Implement Government-approved responsible AI controls, including model explainability, bias assessment, privacy safeguards, human oversight, and appropriate handling of sensitive data.
* Develop and maintain monitoring capabilities to detect model drift, performance degradation, operational failures, and other conditions requiring corrective action.
* Implement safeguards for generative AI applications, including prompt management, output validation, access restrictions, and human-in-the-loop review where required.
* Collaborate with VA stakeholders and technical teams to evaluate AI/ML use cases, assess technical feasibility, and establish production readiness criteria.
* Troubleshoot AI/ML platform and deployment issues, optimize model performance and resource utilization, and support reliable production operations.
* Develop technical documentation, implementation guidance, and reusable reference materials to support adoption and ongoing operation of AI/ML capabilities.
* Contribute technical findings, operational metrics, and recommendations to the Summit AI/ML Health Report and related Government reporting requirements.

* Demonstrated experience deploying, scaling, and supporting AI/ML solutions in enterprise production environments.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure AI/ML technologies, Azure Databricks, or comparable enterprise AI/ML platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python and commonly used machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
* Experience developing machine learning pipelines for model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Experience implementing MLOps practices, including model registries, version control, automated testing, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) workflows.
* Knowledge of predictive modeling, natural language processing, and generative AI technologies and their practical enterprise applications.
* Experience integrating AI/ML solutions with enterprise data platforms, application programming interfaces (APIs), and cloud-based services.
* Understanding of responsible AI principles, including model explainability, bias mitigation, privacy protection, and human oversight.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and technical collaboration skills.
* Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.
* The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

* Experience implementing enterprise AI/ML capabilities in Microsoft Azure Government cloud environments.

**Responsibilities**
The Data Protection team safeguards user data, business data, confidential company information, intellectual property, and other data requiring protection against unauthorized disclosure and exfiltration. We build and operate the platforms, data pipelines, and controls that help teams understand data risks and protect sensitive information across enterprise systems.
  
  
Our focus is on effective, practical protection: understanding how data is accessed, used, and shared; applying controls appropriate to its sensitivity and risk; and enabling reliable, scalable security workflows without unnecessarily disrupting legitimate work.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Engineer to build the engineering foundation of our Data Protection program. This is a software development role focused on backend services, data pipelines, platform integrations, and workflow automation.
  
  
You will turn data protection requirements into production software that connects enterprise systems, processes security and data lifecycle signals, and automates operational workflows. You will work closely with Data Security Engineers, IT, Insider Security, and data platform teams to make data protection capabilities more scalable, reliable, and measurable.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Data Protection Platform Engineering
  
- Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs for data protection capabilities, including data discovery and classification, protection coverage tracking, and policy lifecycle management.
  
- Develop integrations with enterprise DLP platforms, data infrastructure, identity services, and case-management systems through APIs, event streams, and connectors.
  
- Build reusable platform capabilities that enable security engineers to manage configurations, validate controls, and deploy changes through version-controlled, auditable workflows.
  
- Design data models and storage systems for protection metadata, security events, workflow state, and audit records, with appropriate access and retention controls.
  
  
Data Pipelines and Processing
  
- Build and operate batch and streaming pipelines to ingest, normalize, enrich, and correlate data protection signals across enterprise systems.
  
- Integrate data ownership, classification, access, and lineage context to support risk assessment, detection, and investigation workflows.
  
- Implement reliable processing with schema validation, deduplication, retries, replay, and mechanisms to handle late or out-of-order events where needed.
  
- Optimize pipeline throughput, latency, and storage costs while maintaining data quality and limiting unnecessary collection or exposure of sensitive data.
  
  
Workflow Automation
  
- Develop workflow orchestration for policy validation, event enrichment, alert routing, exception management, and remediation tracking.
  
- Integrate automated workflows with approval processes and human review where actions may affect business operations or access to data.
  
- Build reliable execution using idempotent operations, bounded retries, failure recovery, and auditable state transitions.
  
  
Reliability and Engineering Ownership
  
- Own features from requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  
- Build observability for services, connectors, pipelines, and workflows, including metrics, logs, dashboards, and actionable alerts.
  
- Write automated tests and use CI/CD, staged rollouts, and rollback strategies to deliver changes safely.
  
- Investigate production issues, address performance and reliability bottlenecks, and maintain technical documentation and operational runbooks.
  
- Collaborate with security and infrastructure partners to translate data protection needs into clear interfaces, service expectations, and maintainable software.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
- Backend Engineering: 2+ years of professional software engineering experience using Go (Golang), Java, or C++, with Go preferred. Experience building and maintaining production backend services and APIs.
  
- Distributed Systems: Working knowledge of asynchronous processing, service-to-service communication, and distributed system failure modes, including retries, idempotency, and consistency trade-offs.

Preferred Qualifications
  
- Data Protection & Privacy: Prior experience in data protection, DLP, privacy engineering, GDPR/CCPA-related technical controls, or data governance.
  
- Security Engineering: Understanding of encryption at rest and in transit, identity and access management (IAM), least privilege, secrets management, and audit logging.
  
- Workflow Orchestration: Experience with workflow engines such as Temporal or Airflow, or with building durable, event-driven automation across multiple systems.
  
- Enterprise Integrations: Experience integrating security platforms, SaaS applications, identity providers, or case-management systems, including handling API rate limits and connector failures.

**Description**
We are seeking Applied Scientists to join Amazon. In this role, you will develop and deploy the science of safe autonomy on highly dynamic robots, advancing the frontier through both foundational research and realization on hardware. You will contribute to achieving safe autonomy across three key areas: control barrier function (CBF) theory for robust and performant safety on hardware; safe reinforcement learning for agile whole-body control; and layered safety filters that interface with learning, perception, and semantic reasoning systems. You will validate your work experimentally on state-of-the-art robotic platforms — removing bottlenecks to deployment and enabling robots to safely operate around humans. You will work with the inventor of CBFs, as well as top scientists and engineers at Amazon developing the next generation of safe autonomy.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Advance the science of safe autonomy from formal foundations to the integration with learning and perception to validation on hardware — with particular emphasis on methods that bridge these domains.
* Test and validate hardware, with a focus on next generation robotic systems. Including locomotion, manipulation and loco-manipulation.
* Leverage the deployments on hardware to validate the underlying science, identifying gaps between theory and practice that drive the next cycle of research. hardware to validate the underlying science, identifying gaps between theory and practice that drive the next cycle of research.
* Publish research at top-tier robotics, control, and ML venues, and contribute to Amazon’s scientific reputation in advanced robotics.
* Collaborate with SAF Lab and Amazon production teams to move research into robots deployed at Amazon scale.

A day in the life
  
  
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
  
  

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
* Maternity and Parental Leave Options
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* 401(k) Plan

**About The Team**
The Safe Autonomy Frontiers (SAF) Lab is the first industry research lab dedicated to safe autonomy, founded by the inventor of control barrier functions. We are developing a universal safety layer for the next generation of robotic systems: mobile robots, manipulators, quadrupeds, and humanoids. Here you will advance performant safety for highly dynamic robots — CBF theory integrated with perception and learning, evaluated on next-generation platforms — and your work will underpin robots operating alongside people at Amazon’s unprecedented scale.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD or equivalent research experience
* Master’s degree and 3+ years of applied science, research, or robotics engineering experience — OR a PhD — in computer science, robotics, control, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience developing and deploying control algorithms and/or learning policies on physical robotic hardware in a research or production setting (not simulation-only).
* Working knowledge of safety-critical control, including control barrier functions and safety filters.
* Proficiency in C++ and Python, with a track record of implementing control algorithms and/or learning policies in real systems.
* Experience with physics simulators for robotics (e.g., Isaac Gym/Sim, MuJoCo, PyBullet).
* Demonstrated technical impact through shipped systems, patents, or publications at top-tier venues (e.g., CDC, ACC, L-CSS, ICRA, IROS, RSS, RA-L, Automatica, TAC, TRO).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in professional software development, including production code quality, testing, and deployment practices.
* Experience taking robotics or autonomy research from prototype to deployed product, including collaboration with hardware, product, and operations teams.

* Experience with model-based control (MPC, whole-body QP controllers, operational space control) and/or simulation-based predictive control (MPPI).
* Experience with hierarchical RL, skill composition, distillation, and multi-task policy architectures for locomotion.
* Familiarity with real-time deployment constraints (latency budgets, onboard compute limitations, control-loop frequencies).
* Experience building or contributing to large-scale RL training infrastructure (distributed training, GPU clusters).
* Strong communication skills and ability to work across disciplinary boundaries (ML, controls, mechanical engineering).

**Position Description**
Valiant Solutions is hiring an
**Associate Software Engineer**
to build the internal apps, automations, and AI tools that help our staff work faster.
  
  
The
**Associate Software Engineer**
will work directly with people across the company to find slow or error-prone work, then design, build, and measure the fix. Much of this work runs through VITALs (Valiant Innovation Team and Lab), our program that turns staff ideas into custom apps and automations. Inside IT and Engineering, you work alongside the Engineering lead and the IT Systems Administrator. The Engineering lead sets technical direction and priorities. The IT Systems Administrator runs daily IT operations, user support, and software licenses. You build the apps, automations, and AI tools that make the team, and the rest of Valiant, more efficient. All three roles share one backlog and review work together, so ideas move quickly from a support ticket or staff interview to a working tool.
  
  
Named one of the
**Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years**
, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!
  
  
**Location:**
This position allows for 100% remote work.
**Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.**
  
  
**Eligibility:**
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field or equivalent experience. 0 to 2 years of experience. Internships and substantial projects count.
* Working skill in TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python.
* An app, tool, or automation you built that other people used.
* Working knowledge of RESTAPIs, OAuth 2.0, Git, and the Linux command line. Clear communication with technical and non-technical people, in writing and in conversation.
* Ability to learn how a team works, find where it slows down, and plan the fix. Self-direction in a fully remote team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Google Cloud or another major cloud, plus Docker.
* Next.js or React.
* Workflow automation tools, such as n8n, Make.com, or Google Apps Script. LLM APIs, agents, MCP servers, orAI coding tools such as Claude Code. Google Workspace administration or GAM.
* IT support experience.
* Experience training users or running user acceptance testing.

**Responsibilities:**
Your core work is building software, automation, and AI tools that give Valiant staff time back. When IT gets busy, you also help the team with escalations.
  
  
**Build and ship**

* Develop projects from the VITALs backlog, from project charter and definition of done through sprints, launch, and measurement.
* Build and maintain apps on our internal Micro-App Platform for finance, contracts, HR, and other internal teams.
* Move workflows out of low-code apps and into custom apps when they outgrow them.
* Work with the IT Systems Administrator to further automate IT tasks and management, from account provisioning and offboarding to Google Workspace administration and reporting.
* Build and maintain integrations between our business systems.
* Run user acceptance testing with each app's users, and confirm every app works on real tasks before launch.
* Ship through GitHub with code review, CI, tests, and a runbook for each release.

**AI development and enablement**

* Help set Valiant's AI development strategy: where AI fits, how we evaluate it, and how we deploy it securely.
* Build AI features, agents, and automations with LLM APIs and MCP servers, then measure the results against the manual baseline.
* Test new AI models and tools as they release, and recommend what Valiant adopts. Advise Valiant on modern AI tools and research, such as Claude Code and ChatGPT, and keep the company current as the field changes. Your recommendations inform adoption and risk decisions by the CTO and Engineering lead.
* Train staff to use AI tools well through sessions, written guides, and one-on-one help.

**Discover and plan**

* Meet with staff and department leads to learn how their work gets done. Find the slow, manual, or error-prone steps in their workflows, and turn them into scoped plans with a measured baseline.
* Keep exploring new ways technology can improve how Valiant works, and bring forward the ideas worth testing.
* Contribute to the project that defines Valiant's future app architecture, including how apps share data, sign users in, and connect to business systems.

**Tools you may work with.**
These are examples, not requirements. Our tools change as Valiant grows, and you learn most of them on the job.
  
  

* App development: TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python
* Cloud and hosting: Google Cloud (Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Firestore), Docker, Linux
* Automation: n8n, Make.com, Google Apps Script, Bash, GAM
* Business systems: Google Workspace, Unanet, Salesforce, GoDaddy, iCIMS, Knack, Notion, Discord, Supernormal
* Source control and CI: GitHub, GitHub Actions

**Growth and milestones**
This role is built to grow. The apps you build become yours to own: you set their roadmap, work directly with the people who use them, and decide how they improve. As your track record grows, so does your scope, from single features to whole platforms, and from building tools to shaping how Valiant builds them.
  
  
Day 30: Learn the platform, ship a fix to a live app, and join a VITALs discovery session.
  
  
Day 60: Own one automation from end to end, with tests and a runbook.
  
  
Day 90: Take one VITALs project from intake to production, including user acceptance testing.
  
  
Month 6: Own one or more apps end to end. Hold regular check-ins with their department leads, and take part in architecture discussions.
  
  
Month 12: Act as a trusted technical partner to the department leads you support. Help design Valiant's future app architecture, lead discovery for new VITALs projects, and help set the direction of AI development.

**About The Company**
Fivetran, Inc. helps organizations move and manage data so teams can make informed decisions and build dependable data products. The company works across a broad data ecosystem, including its platform and the dbt product, to support customers’ data workflows. At Fivetran, engineering teams build and operate services that must be reliable, scalable, and understandable to the people who depend on them. Collaboration across engineering, product, finance, data, and partner teams is an important part of delivering a cohesive customer experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
Fivetran, Inc. is seeking a Senior Software Engineer for Cloud Signals in Albuquerque, New Mexico. In this role, you will own major features that support billing, usage metering, telemetry, and notifications across the dbt platform and the combined Fivetran and dbt product. You will take responsibility for the full lifecycle of production-grade software, from technical design and implementation through deployment, operations, and ongoing improvement.
  
  
This position calls for an engineer who can balance thoughtful system design with practical execution. You will work with teams across Product, Finance, Data, and partner organizations to understand requirements, develop solutions, and make complex capabilities reliable and clear. You will also mentor fellow engineers and contribute to stronger development practices, including continuous integration and delivery, infrastructure as code, and observability.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualified candidates bring substantial experience building and operating software systems in production, along with the judgment to make sound technical decisions for services that handle important business and product workflows. You should be comfortable owning significant features, communicating trade-offs, and collaborating with colleagues from technical and nontechnical disciplines. The role requires a focus on reliability, scalability, maintainability, and clear ownership.
  
  
Successful candidates can guide work from ambiguous requirements to well-designed, tested, and operational solutions. Experience with billing, metering, telemetry, or notification systems is relevant to the scope of the role. Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and observability practices will help you contribute to the team’s engineering effectiveness. You should also be willing and able to mentor engineers, share knowledge, and support a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Design, build, test, deploy, and operate production-grade software components for Cloud Signals, with ownership extending beyond implementation to the reliability and ongoing performance of the systems you deliver. Develop major capabilities for billing, usage metering, telemetry, and notifications that serve the dbt platform and the combined Fivetran and dbt product.
  
  
Partner with Product, Finance, Data, and other engineering and partner teams to clarify needs, align on technical approaches, and deliver solutions that work across organizational and product boundaries. Apply sound engineering practices to improve service resilience, scalability, and operational clarity. Strengthen CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and observability workflows, and use those practices to make software delivery and production support more dependable. Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing, while helping the team build and maintain a high standard of technical quality.
  
  
**Benefits**
This role offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of critical product capabilities and contribute to systems used across an evolving data platform. You will work with colleagues across multiple disciplines, solve complex engineering problems, and help shape practices for reliable software delivery. You will also have opportunities to mentor others and influence how teams approach service ownership, automation, and observability. Employment benefits and compensation details are provided through the company’s recruiting process.

The company welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds and is committed to a respectful, inclusive workplace. **Description**
Our Annapurna Labs team at Amazon is looking for a Software Development Engineer to own the regression infrastructure that every manufacturing software release depends on. Before new test software reaches a production line, it is validated on real hardware, both in our lab and at our manufacturing sites. You will own those regression systems end to end: the hardware they run on, and the software that keeps them configured, connected and healthy at all times. You'll build the automation that detects problems and repairs systems without manual work, so regression is always ready to gate a release. This is a software role at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, hardware and networking.
  
  
AWS Trainium is at the center of the AI infrastructure race, and our mission is "Silicon never waits." This is a new, high-visibility area with no existing owner, so you'll have wide room to define the architecture, choose the approach and grow the scope as we scale to more sites and new platforms.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the regression infrastructure in our lab and at manufacturing sites, and extend it to every site
* Build software (Python, Go, TypeScript, Java or C++) that configures, monitors and maintains the servers, firmware and network devices regression depends on
* Automate repair: detect failures, recover systems through software, escalate only when hands-on work is needed
* Keep software and firmware versions consistent across lab, manufacturing and fleet environments
* Feed infrastructure health into release pipelines so releases reflect real hardware state
* Partner with hardware, firmware, network and test teams to set standards and clear ownership
* Write runbooks, join on-call, and lead root-cause reviews

A day in the life
  
  
You might start by reviewing overnight health reports for the regression systems and checking that every system is configured, connected and ready. Then you could dig into a recurring failure, write the automation that detects and repairs it, and add a health check so that release pipelines see the result. In the afternoon you might review a teammate's design, join a call with hardware or network engineers to agree on a recovery approach, or plan the next site rollout. Your work keeps releases moving, so every hour you save is an hour sooner that new hardware reaches customers.
  
  
**About The Team**
Manufacturing Automation & Deployment, part of Annapurna ML, builds and runs the software platform that tests and validates AWS Trainium hardware at manufacturing sites worldwide. We deliver test software to active production lines with the release discipline of a cloud service: staged rollouts, regression gates, automated alarming and fast rollback. Our work directly enables the manufacturing ramp of AWS's custom AI chips.
  
  
Machine Learning Accelerators (MLA) is building AI-native racks faster than anyone in the industry, from custom silicon to full rack assembly, and every engineer who joins has room to make a real impact on it.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of software development, or 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent
* Proficiency in at least one of: Python, Go, TypeScript, Java or C++
* Experience with Linux systems and networking fundamentals

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience automating server and network device management, including firmware updates and out-of-band management
* Experience building monitoring, alarming and automated remediation for hardware infrastructure
* Experience operating systems across multiple sites, including edge or on-premises environments
* Experience with AWS, infrastructure as code (CDK, CloudFormation or Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with hardware test automation, hardware validation or manufacturing systems

Do you want to shape how AWS understands and improves the experience of millions of customers? The AWS Experience Analytics team is building a unified analytics, experimentation, and user-insights platform that spans every channel customers use — web, mobile, CLI, SDK, docs, and conversational interfaces. We just shipped our first wave of capabilities and are now designing the next, much larger version: large-scale data pipelines, real-time streaming, applied ML and generative AI, and an intelligence layer that lets teams query insights in natural language. This is an early, formative stage where the architecture and engineering norms are being set, so you won't inherit a finished system — you'll help define it.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will own features end to end — from shaping requirements with product and science partners to shipping production services that AWS service teams rely on to find and fix customer friction. If you're excited about combining open-source technologies, AWS services like Redshift and Kinesis, and big-data and ML techniques to drive the future of the AWS customer experience, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, test, and operate scalable services and data pipelines that power the analytics platform, ensuring reliability and fresh data for downstream consumers.
* Own a meaningful component or feature area end to end — from system design through production deployment and ongoing operations — bringing clarity to problems and identifying simple, maintainable solutions.
* Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and partner engineering teams to translate requirements into working software that improves customer-journey and experience-health metrics.
* Contribute to code reviews and mentor teammates, raising the bar on code quality, documentation, and engineering standards across the team.
* Evaluate and integrate generative AI tools and techniques where they can accelerate development or improve the platform's insights capabilities.

**About The Team**
AWS Experience Analytics is a newly formed organization with a rapidly expanding charter. We own the services and data warehouses AWS uses to gather quantitative insights (analytics, experimentation) and qualitative insights (user feedback, ratings) and turn them into actions that improve the AWS customer experience. Our customers are the service teams across AWS who need reliable metrics and tooling to understand how people use their products.
  
  
Over the coming months and years, we are investing in a unified data-collection-to-insights platform, richer customer-journey metrics across every AWS channel, behavioral segmentation powered by ML, and an agentic insights layer driven by generative AI. It's a collaborative, builder-friendly environment where engineers take on increasing scope as the platform grows.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.
  
  
Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Data Analyst specializing in Financial Operations (FinOps) to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The Data Analyst (FinOps) will analyze cloud consumption, operating costs, and resource utilization to help VA stakeholders understand expenditures, identify optimization opportunities, and make informed decisions about platform investments.
  
  
This position will support financial transparency and cost accountability across the Summit Data Platform by developing cost analyses, forecasts, dashboards, and recommendations that improve resource efficiency while maintaining operational performance and service quality.
  
  
**Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.**
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Analyze Microsoft Azure cloud consumption, spending patterns, and resource utilization across Summit platform services, applications, and customer workloads.
* Develop and maintain financial dashboards, cost reports, and performance indicators that provide visibility into cloud expenditures, usage trends, and cost drivers.
* Monitor cloud budgets, spending thresholds, and consumption trends to identify potential overruns, anomalies, and emerging financial risks.
* Develop cost forecasts and budget projections using historical consumption, workload trends, and anticipated platform demand.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary cloud spending through resource rightsizing, workload scheduling, storage optimization, and other cost management practices.
* Collaborate with cloud engineers, platform administrators, and technical teams to evaluate the financial and operational impact of proposed optimization measures.
* Analyze resource tagging, cost allocation, and consumption data to support accurate attribution of cloud expenses to services, environments, and customer workloads.
* Support implementation of Government-approved FinOps practices, including cost accountability, financial transparency, and continuous optimization.
* Evaluate the cost implications of new platform capabilities, infrastructure changes, and customer onboarding activities.
* Investigate unexpected spending increases and usage anomalies, documenting root causes and recommended corrective actions.
* Develop and maintain financial analysis models, reporting procedures, and supporting documentation to ensure consistent and repeatable cost assessments.
* Prepare cost analysis summaries, financial performance reports, and recommendations for VA stakeholders to support resource planning and management decisions.

**Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Four or more years of professional experience in financial analysis, cloud cost management, business analytics, or a related discipline.
* Experience analyzing cloud infrastructure costs, technology expenditures, or enterprise information technology resource consumption.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Power BI or comparable analytical and reporting tools.
* Experience developing financial dashboards, cost models, forecasts, and variance analyses.
* Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL) or comparable data querying and analysis techniques.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure Cost Management, cloud billing structures, and resource consumption reporting.
* Experience analyzing operational metrics, identifying spending trends, and developing actionable cost optimization recommendations.
* Ability to translate technical consumption data into clear financial findings for business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.
* The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting VA or other federal agency cloud financial management or modernization initiatives.
* Hands-on experience using Microsoft Azure Cost Management, Azure Advisor, or comparable cloud cost optimization tools.
* Experience implementing cloud resource tagging strategies, cost allocation models, or showback and chargeback reporting.
* Knowledge of FinOps Foundation principles and practices, including cloud financial accountability and unit cost analysis.
* Experience analyzing costs associated with Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics, or other cloud-based data processing platforms.
* Experience evaluating cloud pricing models, reserved capacity, savings plans, and workload optimization strategies.
* Experience supporting cloud budget planning, financial governance, and executive-level cost reporting in large enterprise environments.
* FinOps Certified Practitioner or comparable cloud financial management certification.

**PURPOSE AND SCOPE:**
Functions as part of the hemodialysis health care team as a Registered Nurse Applicant, under the direction or supervision of a Staff Registered Nurse, to ensure provision of quality patient care on a daily basis in accordance with FMS policies, procedures, and training. Supports the FMCNA’s mission, vision, values, and customer service philosophy. Supports the FMCNA commitment to the Quality Enhancement Program (QEP) and CQI Activities, including those related to patient satisfaction and actively participates in process improvement activities that enhance the likelihood that patients will achieve the FMCNA Quality Enhancement Goals (QEP). Adheres to all requirements of the FMCNA Compliance Program, and FMS patient care and administrative policies. Employees hired into this position will be required to obtain their nursing license and registration within the timeframe outlined in state specific regulations, or within 90 days from hire date, whichever comes sooner.
  
  
**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**STAFF RELATED:**

* Directs Patient Care Technician’s provision of safe and effective delivery of chronic hemodialysis therapy to patients in compliance with standards outlined in the facility policy procedure manuals, as well as regulations set forth by the corporation, state, and federal agencies.
* Delegates tasks to all direct patient care staff including but not limited to LVN/LPNs, Patient Care Technicians, and Dialysis Assistants.
* Assesses daily patient care needs and develops appropriate patient care assignments.
* Routinely monitors patient care staff for appropriate techniques and adherence to facility policy and procedures.
* Participates in staff training and orientation of new staff as assigned
* Participates in all required staff meetings as scheduled.

**PATIENT RELATED:**
Education:
  
  
  

* Ensures educational needs of patients and family are met regarding End Stage Renal Disease (ESRD).
* Provides ongoing education to patients regarding their renal disease, vascular access and dialysis therapy, and other related health conditions.
* Discusses with patient, and records education related to diet/fluid and medication compliance.
* Provides patient specific detailed education regarding adequacy measures where applicable - Online Clearance Monitoring (OLC), Adequacy Monitoring Program (AMP), Urea Kinetic Modeling (UKM).
* Ensures transplant awareness, modality awareness, and drive catheter reduction.
* Educates patients regarding laboratory values and the relationship to adequate dialysis therapy, compliance with treatment schedule, medications, and fluid.

Dialysis Treatment:
  
  
  

* Provides safe and effective delivery of care to patients with ESRD.
* Accurately implements treatment prescriptions including Sodium (Na) modeling prescription, and Ultrafiltration modeling (where appropriate) to ensure stable treatment therapy as indicated.
* Assesses patients’ response to hemodialysis treatment therapy, making appropriate adjustments and modifications to the treatment plan as indicated by the prescribing physician. Communicates problems or concerns to the Team Leader or physician.
* Identifies and communicates patient related issues to Team Leader or physician.
* Initiates Initial and Annual Nursing Assessment, and ongoing evaluation and documentation of patient care needs according to FMC Policies and Procedures.
* Actively participates in the pre evaluation, initiation, monitoring, termination, access homeostasis, and post evaluation of patients receiving hemodialysis treatment therapy according to established FMC procedures.
* Takes appropriate intervention for changes in patient adequacy status and troubleshooting access flow issues as identified by OLC/AMP yellow lights.
* Provides, supervises (if applicable), and monitors hemodialysis access care according to established procedures.
* Implements, administers, monitors, and documents patient's response to prescribed interdialytic transfusions, including appropriate notification of adverse reactions to physician and appropriate blood supplier.
* Ensures accurate and complete documentation by Patient Care Technician on the Hemodialysis Treatment Sheet.

Laboratory-related:
  
  
  

* Reviews, transcribes, and enters physician lab orders accurately into the Medical Information System.
* Ensures appropriate preparation of lab requisitions for Spectra or alternate lab.
* Ensures correct labs tubes are utilized for prescribed lab specimens and that lab draw and processing procedures are performed appropriately for all lab samples.
* Identifies and ensures appropriate follow-through regarding missed labs and specimens reported to be insufficient according to company policies and procedures.
* Ensures all specimens are appropriately packaged according to Department of Transportation (DOT) policies and procedures relating to shipment of blood or body fluid specimens and potentially hazardous material.
* Ensures that all labs are directed and delivered to appropriate labs.
* Reports alert/panic and abnormal labs results to appropriate physician.
* Ensures lab results are forwarded to physicians as requested.

General duties:
  
  
  

* Enforces all company approved policies and procedures, as well as regulations set forth by state and federal agencies and departments.
* Maintains overall shift operation in a safe, efficient, and effective manner.
* Act as a resource for other staff members.
* Routinely meets with the Clinical Manager to discuss personnel and patient care status, issues, and information.
* Collaborate and communicate with physicians and other members of the healthcare team to interpret, adjust, and coordinate care provided to the patient.
* Provides assistance as needed to patients regarding prescription refills according to FMCNA Policies.
* Ensures all physician orders are transcribed and entered into the Medical Information system in a timely manner.
* Oversees all documentation of patient information.
* Maintains facility drug list for all required stock medications.
* Maintains competency with all emergency operational procedures, and initiates CPR and emergency measures in the event of a cardiac and/or respiratory arrest.
* Ensures verification and availability of adequate emergency equipment.
* Ensures provision of appropriate vaccinations, immunizations, and annual Tuberculosis (TB) testing.
* Administers medications as prescribed or in accordance with approved algorithm(s), and documents appropriate medical justification if indicated.
* Administers PRN medications as prescribed and completes appropriate documentation of assessment of effectiveness.
* Maintains appropriate recording of controlled substances as required by law.
* Assists with the coordination of patient transportation if necessary.

**MAINTENANCE/TECHNICAL:**

* Ensures a clean, safe, and sanitary environment in the dialysis facility treatment area.
* Ensures competency in the operation of all dialysis-related equipment safely and effectively.
* Ensures all patient stations, including machines and chairs, are clean and free of blood and placed appropriately.
* Ensures that all blood spills are immediately addressed according to FMCNA Bloodborne Pathogen Control Policies.

**MEDICAL RECORDS & DOCUMENTATION:**
General
  
  
  

* Ensures all relevant data including physician orders, lab results, vital signs and treatment parameters, and patient status are documented appropriately and entered into Medical Information System.
* Ensures all appropriate patient related treatment data is entered into the Medical Information System.
* Ensures all FMCNA policies regarding patient admission, transfer, and discharge are appropriately implemented.
* Ensures and verify accuracy of Patient Care Technician documentation.

Daily
  
  
  

* Reviews and ensures appropriate daily completion of Hemodialysis Treatment Sheets by all patient care staff.
* Ensures that all appropriate procedures are followed regarding opening and closing procedures, inclusive of monitoring that all staff and patients have safely left the premises.

Monthly
  
  
  

* Initiates, documents, and completes ongoing Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) activities including monthly reports.
* Completes monthly nurses' progress note.
* Ensures patient medical records are complete with appropriate information, documentation, and identification on each page (Addressograph label is on all chart forms).
* Reviews transplant status and follows established procedure regarding appropriate action to be taken.
* Completes patient care plans for new patients within the initial 30 days or any patients deemed unstable requiring monthly patient care plans.
* Completes any long-term programs that are due. Annually
* Completes initial and annual Nursing History and Assessment physical.
* Ensures completion of Annual Standing Order Review with each physician as required.

**The Opportunity (Summer 2026 AI Internship - Applications Open Now)**
We're seeking an
**AI Engineer Intern**
to work alongside our AI team on large-scale AI and Agentic systems from data pipeline to production deployment. This role is scoped for someone with foundational experience who wants to deepen it: you'll own discrete pieces of real systems under the mentorship of senior engineers, not shadow work or isolated coursework-style projects.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You’ll work directly with the AI team, taking responsibility for well-scoped pieces of real systems, with mentorship from senior engineers.
  
  
**Benchmarks & Evaluation**

* Contribute to APIFlow-Bench, our open-source benchmark for real API-development work: design and review benchmark tasks and their mock API environments, extend the evaluation harness and task-generation pipeline in Python, and help maintain the public multi-model leaderboard with statistical confidence intervals.
* Help build a new action-level AI safety benchmark: instead of grading what a model says, it scores what an agent actually does inside a simulated enterprise API environment. You’ll work on scenario design, threat modeling (prompt injection, data exfiltration, permission overreach), and auditable evaluation design.

**Model Training & Efficiency**

* Fine-tune open-weight models for tool calling and agentic tasks (SFT, distillation, and RL) using PyTorch and the open-source training ecosystem, on both managed training platforms and self-managed cloud GPUs.
* Design and run experiments with rigor: evaluate every training run on our benchmarks, support ablation studies and error analysis, track experiments, and report results honestly, including cost.
* Evaluate ultra-low-bit quantized models for on-device use: extend our quantized vs. full-precision benchmark comparisons and analyze where and why they diverge.

**Agent Systems & Engineering Practice**

* Help build the next generation of Postman’s in-product AI agent (Agent Mode): a deliberately minimal agent architecture that calls LLM APIs directly (tool loops, multi-step execution, checkpointing), primarily in TypeScript. No prior TypeScript is required; strong Python fundamentals transfer quickly.
* Read the source code of open-source agent harnesses and turn what you learn into design specs and prototypes.
* Document experiments, design decisions, and runbooks so your work is legible to the next person; flag safety, fairness, or privacy concerns you observe in model or agent behavior.

**About You**

* Currently pursuing a BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Hands-on experience training or evaluating ML models: course projects, research, hackathons, or a prior internship all count.
* Solid Python fundamentals: data structures, functions, basic testing; comfortable writing and reviewing code outside of notebooks.
* Working knowledge of at least one deep-learning framework (PyTorch preferred).
* Clear written and verbal communication, and a habit of documenting what you build.

**Preferred Qualifications**
*(none required; the more of these you have, the better)*

* Experience fine-tuning open-weight LLMs (SFT, LoRA, RL, or distillation), with the improvement measured on a benchmark.
* Experience building LLM agents (tool calling, multi-step loops) or LLM evaluation harnesses/benchmarks, and reporting results with statistical rigor.
* A track record of shipping real software end-to-end: APIs and services, CLIs, Docker, CI/CD, cloud; public code on GitHub is a big plus.
* Interest or experience in AI safety and robustness: red-teaming, prompt injection, agent security, fairness, or interpretability.
* Exposure to model-efficiency work: quantization, low-bit inference, or serving optimization.
* Evidence of rigor and initiative: publications, technical blog posts, ablation studies, or self-driven side projects with quantified results.
* Fluency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) to ship fast while still deeply understanding the systems you build.
